title: NVIDIA Teams Up with South Korean Naver to Invest $1 Billion in a 200-Megawatt AI Power Plant

content_html:
NVIDIA announced on July 24 an investment agreement worth $1 billion (approximately 6.778 billion Chinese yuan) with South Korean internet giant Naver, aiming to expand the previously deployed NVIDIA DSX AI factory to 200 megawatts. This marks another significant move by NVIDIA in its AI infrastructure layout in the Asia-Pacific region, aimed at providing computing power support for AI innovation enterprises in South Korea and the United States.

Backed by Brookfield, total investment targets 9 billion dollars

This collaboration is not solely led by NVIDIA. NVIDIA has also introduced Brookfield Asset Management as a partner, planning to provide up to 9 billion dollars (approximately 61 billion Chinese yuan) in financial support. Since entering the South Korean market in 2014, Brookfield has been a long-term investor in the country, currently managing about 12 billion dollars in South Korean assets, covering infrastructure, real estate, and energy sectors, and has deep local operational roots.

The expanded NVIDIA DSX AI factory will adopt NVIDIA's latest platforms such as Vera Rubin and Blackwell, focusing on the development needs of next-generation AI large models, agents, and AI services. Notably, Naver's ambitions go beyond 200 megawatts - the company plans to further expand its infrastructure scale to 1 gigawatt and launch an AI Agent platform based on NVIDIA's Agent Toolkit this year. From computing infrastructure to application layer platforms, Naver is trying to simultaneously drive upstream and downstream in the AI industry chain, building a complete local AI ecosystem loop.

content_html_zh:
NVIDIA 7 月 24 日宣布与韩国互联网巨头 Naver 达成价值 10 亿美元（约合人民币 67.78 亿元）的投资协议，旨在将之前部署的 NVIDIA DSX AI 工厂扩建至 200 兆瓦。 这标志着NVIDIA在亚太地区AI基础设施布局的又一重大举措，旨在为韩国和美国的AI创新企业提供算力支持。

布鲁克菲尔德支持，总投资目标90亿美元

此次合作不仅仅由 NVIDIA 主导。 NVIDIA还引入Brookfield Asset Management作为合作伙伴，计划提供高达90亿美元（约610亿元人民币）的财务支持。 自2014年进入韩国市场以来，布鲁克菲尔德一直是该国的长期投资者，目前管理着约120亿美元的韩国资产，涵盖基础设施、房地产和能源领域，在当地拥有深厚的运营根基。

扩建后的NVIDIA DSX AI工厂将采用Vera Rubin、Blackwell等NVIDIA最新平台，重点关注下一代AI大模型、智能体和AI服务的开发需求。 值得注意的是，Naver 的野心超越了 200 兆瓦——该公司计划将其基础设施规模进一步扩大至 1 吉瓦，并于今年推出基于 NVIDIA Agent Toolkit 的 AI Agent 平台。 从计算基础设施到应用层平台，Naver正试图同时带动AI产业链上下游，构建完整的本土AI生态圈。
